learning.title: A leftover .git/shallow entry from before the repository was recreated survives fetch --unshallow and fails the Paper provenance gate
learning.trigger: A ui / paper parity lane (runtime, entitlements or artifacts) fails with "Paper profile provenance: Incomplete shallow provenance history" on one runner while the others pass, although the job checked out with fetch-depth: 0.
learning.mistake: Read it first as history lost late in the job (the baseline failure came an hour after checkout), then as a checkout-depth problem. fetch-depth: 0 was already set and the log shows fetch --unshallow ran. The second failure ran the gate two minutes after checkout, on the same runner: across four runs bakery-hetzner-4 passed 0 of 2 paper-parity jobs, bakery-hetzner-2 5 of 5 and bakery-hetzner-1 1 of 1. A read-only look at hetzner-4 found .git/shallow holding one entry, 38f398e8c80c, a commit of the archived pre-recreation repository that no ref contains; hetzner-2 had no shallow file at all. A toy repository whose server still had the boundary commit did not reproduce it, because there --unshallow cleared the entry. So why it survives is an inference, that the current server does not have the commit and cannot send it, not something shown directly. Second occurrence (issue 249, runs 43166064823 and 43183997740): the heal shipped, dropped 38f398e8c80c, and still failed on bakery-hetzner-5 with "kept real shallow boundary 50f687bac8b5". A read-only look (git -c safe.directory=... for-each-ref --contains, no config change) found the only holders were refs/remotes/pull/546/merge and refs/remotes/pull/552/merge, PR-merge tracking refs of the archived repository: fetch --prune of the branch and tag refspecs never removes them. The failing job's own vite ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:8000 lines came after the failed history step and were noise; the lane never got as far as serving anything.
learning.rule: Before a gate that needs complete history, run scripts/ci/heal-stale-shallow.ts (the ci.yml step "Complete git history before the provenance gate" in each paper-parity job). It drops only entries whose commit is absent from the repository or that no branch, remote-tracking ref or tag contains, logs each one with its subject, keeps a real boundary and still fails on it, and changes nothing when git cannot answer. refs/remotes/pull/* (actions/checkout's PR-merge cache, never pruned) does not count as history: an entry only those refs hold, and that HEAD does not reach, is stale, and the script removes those refs first and logs each ("history: removed leftover PR-merge ref ..."). Do not re-provision a host, delete a workspace or weaken the gate to clear it.

verification.requirement: The step's log line "history: dropped stale shallow entry ..." names the entry on a runner that carries one, and shallow-after=false.
A repository with a real boundary (a depth-1 clone) still exits 1 and keeps the file byte for byte; tests/unit/ci-heal-stale-shallow_test.ts covers both.

An entry held by both a PR-merge ref and a branch, tag or origin ref, or reached by the checked-out HEAD, is kept and no ref is touched; only refs/remotes/pull/ is treated as a cache, and a ref that cannot be removed leaves the shallow file unchanged.

learning.boundary: Other jobs that need full history on a runner with such an entry would hit the same refusal until they run the step; only the three paper-parity jobs do today.
